concerns.text: FR-001 mandates "GPT-Neo 350M", which does not exist (GPT-Neo family: 125M/1.3B/2.7B/6B/20B; prior run's 401 confirms). The plan substitutes gpt2-medium (355M) and flags the gap, but the spec itself must be amended so FR-001 is satisfiable as written; otherwise the implementer cannot meet the FR verbatim.

SC-006 asserts 12 runs give ≥90% power at d=0.5, α=0.05; actual power ≈50% (~85/group needed for 90%). The plan honestly reports achieved power and flags the infeasibility, but SC-006 as stated is untestable/false and must be corrected in the spec (e.g., restate as "achieved power is computed and reported").
